description: This file contains functions and constants for parsing source code files, especially TypeScript, using tree-sitter. It includes logic for handling different file extensions, extracting code definitions, and processing syntax captures to identify components, methods, and definitions within source files.

methods.name: getMinComponentLines
methods.description: Returns the current minimum number of lines for a component to be included.

methods.name: setMinComponentLines
methods.description: Sets the minimum number of lines for a component, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: parseSourceCodeDefinitionsForFile
methods.description: Main function to parse a source file and extract code definitions, supporting markdown and various programming languages.
